@[to_additive]

  ⟨{  contMDiff_toFun := contMDiff_const

@[to_additive]

## Progress

Completed `Mumford.analytic-conjugation-bridge` in four verified commits:

- `cd211de29f`: complex-to-real manifold derivative restriction.
- `e7121fc030`: invariant vector fields and integral curves transported through smooth multiplicative maps.
- `a07f6afd46`: intrinsic conjugation derivative equals the identity.
- `5aa93e4263`: conjugation fixes identity-based real flows and [every tangent vector integrates to a central one-parameter subgroup](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/AbelianVarieties/Mumford/MumfordLib/ComplexLieOneParameter.lean:109).

`horizon check MumfordLib` passed all 3,933 jobs. Declaration scans found no `sorry`, `admit`, or project axioms; only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`.

Graph sync reports 1,010 nodes, 170 edges, and `stale=0`. The frozen [commutativity node](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/AbelianVarieties/Mumford/hgraph/nodes/fc445e6aa095.md:7) correctly remains `empty`.

## Issues

This proves individual central real flows, not Mumford’s full commutativity theorem. Joint tangent-parameter regularity, complex differentiability, `d exp₀ = id`, and the local-generation connection remain open.

The required honesty review was satisfactory. A separate load-bearing audit confirmed the complete derivative-to-ODE dependency chain is substantive and non-vacuous. Lean-quality review found only minor future API improvements.

## Why I Stopped

The completed bridge is a coherent verified unit. The next obligation is a distinct parameter-dependent flow construction, not another conditional exponential wrapper.

## Next

Roadmap item `Mumford.analytic-flow-parameter-dependence` is now pending and depends on the completed bridge. Task `fs-mumford` remains `running`, and I-2048 remains open.
I’m checking the ledger’s exact outstanding paths now. I’ll commit only Mumford-owned changes attributable to this session and leave concurrent project paths untouched.
